items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: and Hitler's taking care of business

ctx.x: In fact, I think Burns or somebody went out and told them to keep coming to have some champagne. Then they found out that we're going to work at a place called the Daskin Tabris (phonetic) so they let us go, and we ran amuk there. (unintelligible) and the dancing, those European dances, everybody's working there. Everybody wouldn't / see each other--- One time he called rehearsal because we had to do a radio show and fellows, we would like to have -- don't bother me, I got to see my lawyer, don't ever bother me,…

So, he was afraid anyway. He was back there on a prayer, so we stayed in Holland. Now, we're hearing rumors, those awful rumors, this is the last of '36, through there, '37 and Hitler's taking care of business. The Dutchmen are saying well, he's not coming through here, He's right next to them, but the Dutchmen will fight to kingdom come, that's the type of people they are.

So we finished our contract and then we -- now this is springtime, we goes back into Chez Flordes, the place is called Chez Flordes. This is our place, that's where we were located there in Paris. It was the kings and all royalty. King George, Prince of Wales. I went down there, there were four kings, five kings in the place, King ____, King of Rumania, King Carol, King George of Greece, King George V of England, King Philip of Spain. And I think that was the number there.
